name: Claude Autonomous Coding Agent Demo
description: Minimal harness for long-running autonomous coding with the Claude Agent SDK that builds an app across many sessions.
whatItDoes: Starting from an application spec, it generates a large feature list and implements features one at a time over hours of unattended sessions. It demonstrates patterns for multi-session agent work.
howItWorks: An initializer agent creates feature_list.json and the project scaffold in the first session; later coding-agent sessions start with fresh context, read progress from that file and git history, implement features and mark them passing. Shell commands are limited by an allowlist.
